description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful NatureWalk Home: * New 6-seater golf cart with Bluetooth speakers and backup camera (Drivers must be 21)* 6 Bikes Included* Seagrove Beach has the largest stretch of free, public beaches on 30A, accessible a mile and half away by bike via the Lilly Lane Beach Trail or by golf cart/car via 30A* 2 Large Porches (one screened!) for Relaxing and Dining* 2 Master Suites* Quiet Neighborhood, with biking and walking trails, and surrounded by Point Washington State Forest* Access to "The Gathering Place" with Pools, Hammocks, Grills, Fire Pit, and Pickleball Courts* Walking or Biking Distance to Fabulous Shopping and Dining Options* Next to Watercolor and Seaside* Premium beach towels provided* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service* This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Escape to Sea Esta, a stylish and comfortable 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath vacation home in Seagrove’s sought-after NatureWalk Resort Community. Accommodating up to 11 guests, this coastal retreat offers the perfect blend of relaxed luxury, convenience, and family-friendly amenities. Enjoy resort pools, a hot tub, peaceful nature views, and a screened-in back porch with comfortable seating, a grill, and outdoor TV. Inside, gather in spacious living areas or prepare meals in the chef-inspired kitchen featuring a large island, luxury granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, new GreenPan cookware, and new Pottery Barn wine glasses. The home includes two dedicated workspaces, Smart TVs and ceiling fans in every bedroom, and an upstairs laundry room with a new extra-large Samsung washer and dryer. Sleeping accommodations include two king suites with private bathrooms, a queen bedroom, a three-tier bunk room, and a new Broyhill sleeper sofa. Guests can also explore 30A with four bikes and a 6-passenger golf cart equipped with Bluetooth speakers and a backup camera. Whether you're enjoying the beach, relaxing poolside, biking the nature trails, or exploring nearby Seaside, Sea Esta offers everything you need for an unforgettable 30A getaway.Bed Set-Up:1st Floor:Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa2nd Floor:Master Bedroom 1: King BedMaster Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Triple Twin Bunk Bed* Garage access is limited to the golf cart and included bikes**Due to an HOA restriction, boats, RVs, and trailers are not allowed in this neighborhood**Guests will be charged $150 for a lost or missing amenity pass and $150 for a lost golf cart key. Please leave the amenity pass and the key in the home upon departure.NatureWalk amenities include a large zero-entry pool, an additional heated lap pool, a hot tub, lounge chairs, tables and chairs, a shaded splash pool for toddlers, hammocks, outdoor kitchen with gas grills, and gas fire pit for family enjoyment. Additional amenities include 2 playgrounds, pickleball courts, and a basketball court.Beach access is less than a mile from NatureWalk by bike via the "Lily Lane Beach Trail" through the beautiful Point Washington State Forest. Note: golf carts are not allowed on Lily Lane or any other state forest trails. Golf carts can be driven to all of the beautiful beaches along 30A.NatureWalk is ideally located on Hwy 395 off of 30A, adjacent to WaterColor and Seaside. NatureWalk is surrounded by Point Washington State Forest. Explore NatureWalk and the surrounding WaterColor and Seaside by bike or on foot. Rent a kayak or paddleboard and explore Western Lake or the gulf at Grayton Beach State Park nearby.Publix in “WaterColor Crossings” is conveniently located next to NatureWalk. There you will also find Pizza by the Sea, Boca Boutique, Marble Slab Creamery, Great American Cookie, UPS Store, Emerald Coast Wine and Spirits, Perfect Pig Restaurant, Pedego Electric Bikes, and Yellowfin Sports to meet all of your needs. The shops and restaurants of Seaside, WaterColor, and Seagrove Beach are a short bike or golf cart ride away. Don’t miss the funky shops and restaurants in Old Grayton Beach also on 30A.Area Attractions:30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s finest with sugar white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses and more along the 19-mile stretch of 30A. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayaking, paddleboarding, biking, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis—you'll find it all right here. Read less
